items.title: Senior IS leader killed in joint operation, US and Nigeria say
items.description: President Donald Trump said the operation eliminated "the most active terrorist in the world", Abu-Bilal al-Minuki.

items.title: Trump warns Taiwan against declaring independence, hours after summit with China's Xi
items.description: The US president says he wants Beijing and Taipei to "cool down" tensions over the self-governing island.

items.title: Trump and Xi conclude 'very successful' talks but few deals confirmed
items.description: There were plenty of choreographed ceremonies but no trade breakthroughs after the two-day visit.

items.title: Switzerland to open secret files on Auschwitz 'Angel of Death' Mengele
items.description: Mengele fled Europe after the war but for years there were rumours he spent time in Switzerland.

items.title: Man killed by 13ft great white shark in Western Australia
items.description: The man was bitten just before 10:00 (03:00 BST) at Horseshoe Reef - north-west of the popular Rottnest Island near the city of Perth, local police said.

items.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
items.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

items.title: New outbreak of Ebola kills 80 in eastern DR Congo
items.description: Africa's top health agency says around 246 cases have been reported - a case has also been reported in Uganda.

items.title: US planning to criminally indict ex-Cuban leader Raúl Castro
items.description: Charges could come as soon as next week in a case reportedly focused on Cuba's downing of two planes in 1996.

items.title: Palestinian leaders hold rare party meeting as polls show rising discontent
items.description: The Fatah faction elects top decision makers, but ordinary Palestinians feel the party and its leader are out of touch.

items.title: Judge declares another mistrial in Harvey Weinstein New York rape case
items.description: It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul.

items.title: Hamas confirms top commander killed in Israeli air strike
items.description: Friday's strike is the latest launched by Israel on Gaza despite a ceasefire with Hamas.

items.title: Trump says 20-year nuclear programme suspension by Iran would be enough
items.description: The US president says Tehran has to show "real" commitment to removing nuclear fuel and stopping uranium enrichment.
